package compile
import (
 "os"

 "testing"

 "github.com/matrixorigin/matrixone/pkg/sql/colexec"
 "github.com/matrixorigin/matrixone/pkg/sql/plan/function"
 "github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)
func TestLoomOfficialMain120MissingSetKey(t *testing.T){
 require.Equal(t,int64(120),defines.MORPCLatestVersion)
 c,_:=expressionProtocolTestCompile(t)
 for _,typ:=range []types.T{types.T_float32,types.T_float64}{
  data,err:=os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(os.Getenv("MO_LOOM_PROBE_DIR"),typ.String()+".wire"));require.NoError(t,err)
  var p pipeline.Pipeline;require.NoError(t,p.Unmarshal(data))
  key,control:=p.InstructionList[0].ProjectList[0],p.InstructionList[0].ProjectList[1]
  _,exists:=function.GetFunctionByIdWithoutError(key.GetF().Func.Obj);require.False(t,exists)
  require.NoError(t,validateRemoteExpressionPipelineProtocol(c.proc,&p))
  native,err:=colexec.NewExpressionExecutor(c.proc,control);require.NoError(t,err);native.Free()
  native,err=colexec.NewExpressionExecutor(c.proc,key);require.Nil(t,native);require.ErrorContains(t,err,"function overload id not found")
  t.Logf("official version=%d type=%s wireAdmission=accepted function601=false ordinaryControl=constructed keyErr=%v",defines.MORPCLatestVersion,typ,err)
 }
}
